Yes — the underlying form جَم is Arabic.
Cem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Cem, cem. Script forms are جم, جَم, जेम.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
